title: auth-api-401-429-debug-scratchpad-lena-2026-02-28
content:
Context:
- Spikes of 401 and 429 observed starting 2026-02-28 10:30 UTC. Affects a subset of customers (mobile apps + one third-party integration). Web clients mostly OK.
- First pass: suspected key rotation at 10:20 UTC, but rotation was rolled out earlier and should have been backwards-compatible.

Observed symptoms / logs (examples):
- 401 pattern:
  curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
    -d '{\"input\":\"ping\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

  HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
  Content-Type: application/json
  {\"error\":{\"message\":\"Unauthorized\",\"code\":\"invalid_api_key\"}}

  - Logs from api-gateway show: \"auth: token validation failed: signature mismatch\" for many of the 401s. But the same token works from cURL in my shell for some clients.

- 429 pattern (bursty):
  HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
  Retry-After: 5
  X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
  X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
  X-RateLimit-Reset: 1700001234
  {\"error\":{\"message\":\"Rate limit exceeded\",\"code\":\"rate_limit\"}}

  - 429s are concentrated geographically (east-us-1) and in same time window as a traffic surge + autoscaler churn.

Commands & queries I've run:
- tail -f /var/log/api-gateway/*.log | grep \"invalid_api_key\" -- shows device ids + incoming ip
- grep -R \"signature mismatch\" /var/log/auth-service/* | head
- kubectl logs deploy/auth-service -n prod --since=1h | jq -c '.message' | grep -i \"token\"
- rwctl keys list --env prod  # confirm active keys and creation times
- rwctl keys rotate --env prod --simulate --key-id key_1234  # dry-run seemed fine
- curl -v to inspect response headers (Retry-After, X-RateLimit-*)
- prometheus query: sum(rate(api_requests_total{status=\"429\",route=\"/v1/generate\"}[5m])) by (region)
- BigQuery: SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE status=401 AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY client_app_id

Hypotheses (ordered by my priors):
1) Stale cached API key in mobile app / SDK cache\   - Evidence: rotating the key fixed some web clients but many mobile clients continued failing.\   - Verify: users reporting app update times; check device telemetry for key version header (x-client-key-version).
2) Per-key rate-limit/quota exceeded (per-app-per-region limit)\   - Evidence: 429s show X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and Reset in near future. Spike aligns with marketing campaign + bot traffic.\   - Verify: correlate client_id with X-RateLimit-Limit from our rate-limit table; check quota usage logs.
3) Gateway-level throttling (CloudFront / CDN) vs service-level 429s\   - Evidence: some 429s have headers injected by gateway (X-Amz-Cf-Id present), others are returned by service.\   - Verify: compare request_id prefix; check edge logs vs origin logs.
4) Partial key revocation or misconfiguration during rotation (key IDs mismatched)\   - Evidence: signature mismatch logs + tokens that should be valid fail.\   - Verify: inspect jwk sets served by auth-service; request jwks.json and confirm kid matches.
5) Clock skew / timestamp issues causing signed tokens to be treated as not-yet-valid\   - Less likely but possible for embedded devices.

What I tried and immediate results:
- Rotated the primary API key (key_1234 -> key_5678) and kept old key valid for 1h: web customers recovered quickly, mobile clients not.
- Issued short-lived test token via dev UI and called same endpoint from problematic device IP: token works -> argues against IP-level block.
- Increased rate-limit quota for a small sample key to see if 429s stop: sample key stopped returning 429s for that client, suggests quota enforcement is real and per-key.
- Disabled gateway WAF rules for one traffic shard (10 minutes): no change in 401 cluster.

Important breadcrumbs / traces to follow up on:
- Correlate failing requests by client_app_id + device_id + api_key_kid.
- Check auth-service jwks endpoint at 10:15-10:30 (rotation window) for multiple values of kid. Audit log shows a key-publish event at 10:18.
- Look at token creation logs from mobile SDK: many tokens minted at 09:58 with exp far in future -> if client cached old token it should still work (so signature mismatch points to key mismatch).

Immediate next steps (short list):
- [ ] Pull sample failing request headers and full raw token from logs (PII caution: redact).
- [ ] Query rate-limit table for top 20 clients by 429 count last 1h.
- [ ] Reproduce on a problematic mobile device: capture network (mitmproxy) to confirm key in Authorization header.
- [ ] Check jwks.json history (S3 bucket) for 2/28 10:00-10:30 to see what keys were served.
- [ ] Roll back rotation edge-case: re-enable old key for longer window if needed.

Longer-term follow-ups:
- Add key-version header (x-client-key-version) in SDK to help debug future rotations.
- Add more granular metrics: per-key-per-region RPS, 401/429 rates, and top failure reasons.
- Automate detection: if >50% of requests for a key are 401s within 10m, trigger alert + safe rollback.

Notes to self / random ideas:
- Might be worthwhile to add a temporary endpoint that verifies token->kid mapping: send token, respond with kid that validated it. (Internal-only)
- Consider adding a migration mode during rotation: accept both JWK sets for a configurable window, and add telemetry that reports which kid was used per request.

Open questions for the team:
- Did anyone change key publishing behavior in the last deploy? (cc @Aisha @Michael)
- Do we have per-device SDK telemetry that records key version? Mobile SDK should (if instrumented).

Owner / status:
- Owner: Lena Choi (me). Will continue to iterate, will ping infra-auth and mobile SDK owners after I collect sample tokens.

Raw notes dump (for reference):
- 2026-02-28 10:31:12 UTC: client=acme-mobile device=ios-14.8 ip=3.90.12.45 status=401 msg=\"signature mismatch\"
- 2026-02-28 10:31:22 UTC: client=acme-mobile device=ios-14.8 ip=3.90.12.45 status=401 msg=\"invalid_api_key\"
- 2026-02-28 10:32:10 UTC: client=partner-x ip=13.32.44.10 status=429 X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 X-RateLimit-Limit=120

If you find anything else, drop it in this doc. I'll update with sample tokens (redacted) + final RCA when done.

-- Lena
